known.via: English Wikipedia "San Luis Obispo Coast AVA"

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A cool coastal Central Coast AVA between the Santa Lucia Mountains and the Pacific, about 70 miles long. Most vineyards lie within six miles of the ocean, with Pinot Noir and Chardonnay commonly grown. Its alternate name is SLO Coast.
